title: Your ally is under attack
story: Runners reach the Bahay ng Datu: warriors from {enemy} are attacking {neighbor}. {datu} asks for defenders.

choices.label: Send half your Mandirigma
choices.result: Your warriors set out to defend {neighbor}.

choices.label: Keep them home
choices.result: {neighbor} faces {enemy} alone. {datu} will not forget it.

sources: William Henry Scott, Barangay: Sixteenth-Century Philippine Culture and Society (Ateneo de Manila University Press, 1994)
